svg.text: The same boss all game sets each quarter’s quota and budget. Savings buy growth. The factory grows until you need foremen, and you never leave the floor.
a new line, a machine, a robot
How the floor grows (titles are just flavor the boss hands out)
one line, you instruct every robot
a second stage, your first foreman
What the boss does to you, you later do to your foremen.
→ you give each line a share
Except standing rules: the boss never gives you those. You have a brain.
Keep saving, and one day your savings buy the company out from under the boss.
Then post-game: you own the company and keep running it.
